question: In June 2025, with which of the following countries did Kolkata-based Garden Reach Shipbuilders and Engineers Limited (GRSE) sign an MoU to build the India’s first ever Polar Research Vessel (PRV) indigenously?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Norway**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• In **June 2025**, the **Kolkata**-based **Garden Reach Shipbuilders and Engineers Limited (GRSE)** signed a significant Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) with **Norway**-based maritime technology leaders (specifically **Kongsberg Discovery**) to facilitate the design and development of India’s first indigenous **Polar Research Vessel (PRV)**.
 
• The **Polar Research Vessel** is a specialized ship designed to carry out scientific research in the extreme environments of the **Antarctic** and **Arctic** regions, featuring a reinforced hull for **ice-breaking** capabilities.
 
• This partnership marks a milestone in the **Atmanirbhar Bharat** (Self-reliant India) initiative, as it aims to build a complex, high-technology vessel within the **country** for the first time, reducing dependence on foreign chartered ships.
